shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A man in an orange shirt sits in the shelf-side aisle seat and calls the club meeting to order, while a woman in a white shirt occupies the doorway-side aisle seat, a man in a blue shirt occupies the shelf-side window seat, and a woman in a yellow shirt occupies the doorway-side window seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the doorway end, looking along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats and the shelving unit in frame.

shots.content: The man in the orange shirt asks the woman in the white shirt to review the meeting agenda, and she agrees.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the window side, centered on the two adjacent aisle-side seats.

shots.content: The man in the orange shirt reads the club report.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the window side, centered on the person at the shelf-side aisle seat.

shots.content: The man in the orange shirt asks about the next club project, the woman in the white shirt suggests an article, and the man in the blue shirt agrees.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the game table.
